newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asia crude paper; Brent/Dubai steady, Tapis down.
newsitem.headline: Asia crude paper; Brent/Dubai steady, Tapis down.

text.p: The Brent and Dubai paper crude markets were steady in light talk while Tapis fell on Tuesday as players waited for London to kick in later in the day.
London was closed Monday for a national holiday.
Traders assessed the Brent/Dubai market Tuesday at a notional $1.65/$1.73. A U.S. refinery offered the October Brent/Dubai at $1.73. Otherwise discussion was quiet.
The October numbers compared with Monday's notional market of $1.62/$1.75.
Dubai intermonth levels were steady with October/November assessed at 36/40 cents versus a day-earlier at 32/40, while November/December was valued at 33/38 cents versus 32/40.
Paper Tapis levels fell to a notional $19.45/$19.75 per barrel compared with day-earlier levels that were 20 cents higher. October was assessed at 15 cents backwardation.
Traders said Tapis moved down in line with the weakness of the NYMEX crude futures market. NYMEX October fell in New York on Monday 34 cents to $21.62.
Brent futures were closed. London October Brent settled on Friday at $20.41 and at $1.55 below October NYMEX.
